title: Prince of Persia Assist Mode
summary: Apple II Prince of Persia game with hints, debug cheats, maps, local save, and gameplay rewind functionality.

title: Zork Assist Mode
summary: Classic Zork text adventure with hints, maps, local save, and undo functionality.

title: Wolfenstein 3D Assist Mode
summary: Wolfenstein 3D with cheats, maps, and links to interesting code.

title: DOOM Assist Mode
summary: DOOM cheats and links to interesting code.

title: Karate Rhythm
summary: A rhythm-based runner inspired by Karateka. Time your kicks to the beat of the music to defeat enemies.

title: Emblem Tactics
summary: Fire emblem-inspired TRPG with roguelike elements. Each playthrough features procedurally generated maps.

title: Group Text Adventure
summary: A collaborative text-based adventure game where you and your friends can solve puzzles and progress through the story together.

title: Code Museum
summary: Annotated source code from historically significant open-sourced programs. Read the code that changed computing.

title: Enhanced Classics
summary: Classic public-domain books with AI-generated annotation cards based on Wikipedia articles. The enhanced sections include interesting related context like a documentary for a book.

title: Titan Mining Simulator
summary: A mining simulation game where you can explore and extract resources from Saturn's moon Titan.

title: Applesoft Basic Interpreter
summary: Relive printing your name on the screen with an interpreter for the Applesoft BASIC programming language, allowing you to run simple text-based BASIC programs.

title: Shared Countdown Timer
summary: Ok, not a game. A shared countdown timer for synchronized countdowns with all your friends.
